name: Chat history, confirm deleting all
summary: The all-chats gate. Same body as the counted one, different title — and the button behind it still reads Delete 3 chats.

looseEnds.title: The dialog says all while the button behind it says three
looseEnds.detail: Three of four rows are ticked and the counted button reads 'Delete 3 chats', but the alert over it is titled 'Delete all chats?'. One of the two is wrong: either this gate belongs to the four-ticked state, or the all-chats wording is reached from a partial selection.
looseEnds.ask: Confirm which selection this gate belongs to, and whether all-chats is a separate action from deleting every row one by one.

looseEnds.title: The dialog layer is called 'Delete memory'
looseEnds.detail: The alert is a layer named 'Delete memory', copied from the Memory section.
